class.name: GridContainer
class.brief_description: A container that arranges its child controls in a grid layout.
class.description: [GridContainer] arranges its child controls in a grid layout. The number of columns is specified by the [member columns] property, whereas the number of rows depends on how many are needed for the child controls. The number of rows and columns is preserved for every size of the container. [b]Note:[/b] [GridContainer] only works with child nodes inheriting from [Control]. It won't rearrange child nodes inheriting from [Node2D].

members.member: The number of columns in the [GridContainer]. If modified, [GridContainer] reorders its Control-derived children to accommodate the new layout.

网格中每一行和每一列的逐项偏移量，单位为像素。第 0 行和第 0 列保持原位；[code]x[/code] 分量使后续每一行整体水平偏移该值，正值向右、负值向左，[code]y[/code] 分量使后续每一列整体垂直偏移该值，正值向下、负值向上。两个分量可以同时使用，使整个网格沿行和列两个方向斜向排列。 偏移范围会计入最小尺寸和期望尺寸：宽度额外增加 [code]abs(item_skew.x) * (行数 - 1)[/code]，高度额外增加 [code]abs(item_skew.y) * (列数 - 1)[/code]。倾斜只改变子控件的最终矩形位置，不改变每个子控件自身的大小，也不会拉伸或旋转子控件。在从右到左布局中，[code]x[/code] 分量仍然按控件坐标的正方向解释。
